title: failure-mode-mapping-and-token-sli-shed-control-dashboard
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Goal: build a single-pane observability surface that maps token-level latency SLIs to concrete failure modes across regions and exposes circuit-breaker / load-shedding signals so on-call and SRE can rapidly diagnose and mitigate service degradation. This ticket covers three deliverables: (1) a failure-mode taxonomy and mapping layer that links concrete telemetry to SLO breach types (KV cache degradation, batching collapse, kernel OOMs, network egress contention), (2) new Prometheus/Tracing queries and synthetic traffic harnesses for per-token SLIs (p50/p95/p99 token emission latency, token-drop rate), and (3) a dashboard buildout showing region-to-region heatmap, per-shard token latency distributions, circuit-breaker tripped rate, and active shedding policies. The dashboard should also show correlated signals: KV cache hit rate, batch size distribution, GPU utilization, and routing fallback counts.
acceptance_criteria: Failure-mode taxonomy documented and approved by SRE/Research
Prometheus queries return stable token-level SLIs with <10% CPU overhead from instrumentation in canary cluster
Dashboard panels: regional heatmap, token percentile timelines, circuit-breaker state stream, active shedding policies list, and one-click runbook links
Synthetic workload can reproduce a failure-mode and cause circuit breaker to trip in staging without violating safety guardrails
On-call runbook updated with remediation steps and PagerDuty play triggered by composite SLO alert
design_notes: Taxonomy draft: latency amplification (KV miss -> longer decode), tail-amplification (burst queuing -> p99 jump), degradation cascade (node OOM -> routing surge -> regional fallback), graceful-degradation (prefix trimming, token drop), and throttling (rate limits and 429 patterns)
Prefer percentiles computed at ingest-time histogram buckets (hdrhistogram) to avoid client-side tail-chasing; will expose p50/p95/p99 and p99.9 for tokens
Dashboard will include a Sankey-style trace from incoming request -> shard -> model variant -> final token emission time to help attribute latency sources
implementation_plan: 1) Instrumentation: add token-level emission timer to runtime span (start at request enqueue, measure per-token emission delta). Add tag for model_variant, shard_id, region, KV_cache_hit (bool)
2) Telemetry pipeline: aggregate per-token histograms at 1m resolution; expose Prometheus metrics token_latency_bucket{region,shard,model_variant}
3) Circuit breaker metrics: expose regional_backpressure_ratio, cb_state{region, policy}, shed_actions_total{policy}
4) Synthetic harness: create a k6 script and internal load generator that runs prefix-heavy bursts to test graceful_prefix_trimming and shed controls
5) Dashboard: Grafana panels + read-only Console view. Wire runbook links to Confluence and add an Investigate button that opens traces for a chosen time window
6) Testing: run in staging, validate CPU/ingest overhead, iterate on histogram bucket boundaries
telemetry_queries: Tracing: span[service=runtime AND name=token_emit] | group_by(model_variant, region) | percentile(99, duration_ms)
dashboards_to_create: Region Failure Heatmap: region x time p99 token latency, overlay circuit-breaker tripped count
Shard Distribution: per-shard token p50/p95/p99 and batch size histograms
Circuit Breaker Stream: timeline of CB state changes, policy IDs, and impacted traffic fraction
Load-shedding Actions: list of active shedding rules (policy, threshold, last_triggered) and recent synthetic test outcomes
Correlation Panel: KV cache hit rate vs token p99 with scatter + regression line for root-cause hints

2025-02-18 Lena Ortiz (PM): Approved taxonomy draft. Suggest adding a label for customer-facing impact and mapping to SLA tiers.

2025-02-25 On-call test: Simulated KV-cache starvation in staging. Circuit breaker tripped as expected, synthetic job recorded shed actions. Need to refine alert thresholds to avoid thrash.

2025-02-28 Aisha Khan: Iteration meeting notes — lower CB hysteresis by 20% for P0 regions, add a safety gate that prevents cross-region fallback if overall cluster latency > 5s. Assign follow-up ENG-18801 for threshold tuning.
